sections.title: Why Classes Died
sections.body: A Class A gave away 16 million addresses to one company — massive waste. The world switched to CIDR (/prefix), where the mask can be ANY length.

sections.body: A = Awesome big, B = Balanced medium, C = Cute small, D = Distribution (multicast), E = Experiments.
